longDescription:
Square Menu Board turns your Square item library into a menu on your screens: categories, names, prices, and pictures, kept current every few minutes. When an item sells out at your location, the menu says so.

Prices and availability always come from Square, so a screen never shows a price your register does not charge. You can still shorten a name for the sign, change the order, or hide an item, and those choices stay when Square sends its next update. Tilecast reads your library with read-only access and never changes it.

screenshots.alt: A menu screen with Coffee, Tea, and Bakery sections, a picture beside Latte, prices on the right, and Matcha struck through and marked Sold out.
